def test_read_items_accepts_decimal_comma(tmp_path):
    # spreadsheets saved with an Italian locale use a decimal comma
    path = tmp_path / "it.csv"
    path.write_text('sku,name,on_hand,unit_cost\nB-200,Bolt,5,"0,08"\n', encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_items(path)[0].unit_cost == Decimal("0.08")

def test_overshipping_raises_insufficient_stock(items):
    from inventory.ledger import InsufficientStock

    assert issubclass(InsufficientStock, ValueError)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientStock):
        Ledger(items).ship("W-110", 1)
